Software

SurrogateRank

This R package implements nonparametric rank-based methods for the identification and evaluation of surrogate markers in a small-sample setting. A tutorial can be found here.

predictomics

This R package provides a standardised interface for prediction tasks in the context of omics data. It is not yet available on CRAN.
